correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated all subsets through size four on the duad–syntheme incidence graph using exact integer weights in units of 2⁻²⁸; replay: python3 /workspace/audit_work/record2.py. The counts of porous dominating sets at sizes 0–4 are (0,0,0,0,45), with precisely the sets obtained from flags. Blocked distances cannot be shorter than porous distances, so it suffices to recheck these 45 sets with all other sources deleted separately for each distance term. Every one has the same outside weight multiset: sixteen 9/8, eight 21/16 and two 3. This proves both minima and both classifications without relying on the supplied scripts. All 990 unordered comparisons gave 540 intersections of size zero and 450 of size one. For each state the 20 neighbors and their neighbors reach all 45 states, giving the distance profile (1,20,24), and hence radius and diameter two. For the analytic e=1 case at RESULT.md line 28, once the unique disjoint pair is 01,34 the two remaining duads must come from 03,04,13,14 and meet each other, so they are all equivalent to 13,14 by relabeling preserving the unordered pair of blocks. The listed second representative includes an extra disjoint pair and is extraneous; the first covers all actual e=1 cases. This does not affect the theorem.
